 Dyah (pronounced Dee-yah) is a Senior Author at Collider , responsible for both writing and transcription duties. She joined the website in 2022 as a Resource Writer before stepping into her current role in April 2023. As a Senior Author, she writes Features and Lists covering TV, music, and movies, making her a true Jill of all trades. In addition to her writing, Dyah also serves as an interview transcriber, primarily for events such as  San Diego Comic-Con,  the  Toronto International Film Festival , and the  Sundance Film Festival .
Dyah graduated from Satya Wacana Christian University in October 2019 with a Bachelor's degree in English Literature , concentrating on Creative Writing. On March 2026, Dyah graduated  with Master's degree in English Literature Studies , with a thesis on intersectionality in postcolonial-feminist studies in Asian literary works.
 Born and raised between Indonesia and Singapore , Dyah is no stranger to different cultures. She now resides in the small town of Kendal with her husband and four cats, where she spends her free time cooking or cycling.

 From HBO’s The Sopranos to Paramount+’s MobLand , dysfunctional mob families make for great television — but no other group of criminals is quite as cunning, conniving, and calculating as the Shelby family from Netflix’s Peaky Blinders . Starring Oscar-winning Cillian Murphy as the notorious Shelby ringleader Thomas “Tommy” Shelby, Peaky Blinders takes viewers back to Small Heath, Birmingham, in 1919, the town that would witness the Shelbys’ rise, peak, and eventual downfall.

 Violence and bloodshed are expected in the series, but Peaky Blinders is just as much a family drama as it is a crime epic . Blood may be thicker than water, but Tommy is a businessman first and a family man second. Across six seasons , Peaky Blinders delivers no shortage of shocking plot twists to keep audiences hooked, made all the more surprising by the fact that many come from the people closest to Tommy.
 What Is 'Peaky Blinders' About?
 Inspired by the real-life street gang , Peaky Blinders follows Tommy, fresh out of serving in World War I, as he returns to Small Heath with plans to turn his family’s small horse-betting operation into a legitimate business . His opportunity comes when his men stumble upon a crate of stolen military weapons, setting his bigger plans for the Peaky Blinders into motion. From blackmailing police authorities and taking territory from rival gangs to expanding into bigger cities , each season sees Tommy taking another step toward legitimizing Shelby Company Limited .

 Collider Exclusive · 8 Questions · 2 Minutes 
 Which Netflix Character Would Be Your Best Friend? 
 Dustin · Emily · Wednesday · Gi-hun 
 Some friends drag you out of the house. Some sit with you on the worst night of your life. Netflix has written both, plus the one who tells you the truth you have been avoiding all week. Answer eight quick questions about how you actually do friendship, and find out which of them was always going to end up in your corner. 
 🧢 Dustin (Stranger Things) 
 🗼 Emily (Emily in Paris) 
 🕷️ Wednesday (Wednesday) 
 🟢 Gi-hun (Squid Game) 
 FIND YOUR BEST FRIEND → 
 QUESTION 1 / 8 MEETING 
 01 
 How do you usually end up making a new friend? 
 The origin story says a lot about the friendship that follows it. 
 A We got loud about the same obsession and never stopped. 
 B They invited me somewhere before we had properly met. 
 C We bonded over disliking exactly the same thing. 
 D They noticed I was struggling and stayed with me. 
 NEXT QUESTION → 
 QUESTION 2 / 8 SATURDAY 
 02 
 What is a perfect Saturday with your best friend? 
 Friendship is mostly built out of very ordinary hours. 
 A A ridiculous plan neither of us should attempt. 
 B Somewhere new, photographed heavily, ending very late. 
 C Somewhere quiet, few people, zero small talk. 
 D Something simple, and a conversation that actually matters. 
 NEXT QUESTION → 
 QUESTION 3 / 8 THE CALL 
 03 
 You call them at two in the morning. What happens? 
 This is the real test of a friendship, and everybody knows it. 
 A They are already putting their shoes on. 
 B They answer instantly and turn it into a plan. 
 C They answer and say something unflattering and true. 
 D They listen for an hour and never check the time. 
 NEXT QUESTION → 
 QUESTION 4 / 8 HONESTY 
 04 
 What do you want from them when you are clearly wrong? 
 The best friendships are the ones that survive being corrected. 
 A Support first. We can review the mistake later. 
 B A relentlessly positive reframe of the entire disaster. 
 C The blunt version. Do not soften it for me. 
 D Patience, and no judgment about how I got here. 
 NEXT QUESTION → 
 QUESTION 5 / 8 YOU 
 05 
 What do your friends actually value about you? 
 The friend you attract says something about the friend you are. 
 A I am all in, always, about everything. 
 B I can turn almost any situation into a good time. 
 C I say the thing nobody else in the room will. 
 D I look after whoever is having the worst day. 
 NEXT QUESTION → 
 QUESTION 6 / 8 FALLING OUT 
 06 
 You have a falling out. How does it go? 
 How a friendship repairs itself matters more than how it breaks. 
 A Loudly, briefly, then back to normal by Tuesday. 
 B They apologise first, enthusiastically, with a gift. 
 C Cold silence, then one dry joke that fixes everything. 
 D We talk until we both understand what actually happened. 
 NEXT QUESTION → 
 QUESTION 7 / 8 THE GAP 
 07 
 What do you actually need a best friend for? 
 Everybody is missing something. The right friend fills that gap. 
 A To make my life bigger than it would be alone. 
 B To push me out of the house and into my own life. 
 C To catch me when I start lying to myself. 
 D To be the person who never gave up on me. 
 NEXT QUESTION → 
 QUESTION 8 / 8 TEN YEARS ON 
 08 
 Ten years from now, what keeps the two of you close? 
 Eight questions in, this is the one that decides who you get. 
 A We would still drop everything for each other, instantly. 
 B We still make plans, and we still actually go. 
 C We still cut through each other's nonsense in one sentence. 
 D They stood by me once when it cost them something. 
 REVEAL MY BEST FRIEND → 
 The Group Chat Has Spoken 
 Your Best Friend Is… 
 Four Netflix characters, four completely different ways of showing up
 for somebody. This is the one who fits how you actually do friendship, and what having them in your
 life would be like.
 Stranger Things · Netflix · Since 2016 
 Dustin Henderson 
 You do not do friendship at half volume, and neither does he.
 What you want is somebody who says yes to the plan before you have finished describing the
 plan.
 Dustin is the friend the entire show runs on: loyal past the point of sense,
 enthusiastic about everything, and incapable of leaving anybody behind.
 You have the same instinct. Your friendships are loud, specific and slightly ridiculous,
 and they last for decades because of it.
 He is also the one person who would take your strangest interest completely seriously,
 which is far rarer than it sounds.
 You would have a group chat. It would never once be quiet.
 Emily in Paris · Netflix · Since 2020 
 Emily Cooper 
 You are the friend who makes things happen, and so is she.
 Together you would be mildly exhausting to everyone around you and completely delighted with
 yourselves.
 Emily treats an ordinary Tuesday as something that could be turned into an occasion,
 which is either the best or the worst quality in a friend depending on your energy
 levels.
 You share her refusal to sit still. Neither of you has ever accepted a night in when
 something was happening somewhere else.
 She is far more loyal than people give her credit for. She defends her friends loudly,
 publicly, and occasionally before checking the facts.
 She would post the photo without asking. You would forgive her, because it is a very
 good photo.
 Wednesday · Netflix · Since 2022 
 Wednesday Addams 
 You have no patience for pleasant lies, and she has no ability to
 tell them. What looks like coldness from the outside is the most reliable friendship on this
 list.
 Wednesday never says a kind thing she does not mean, which makes the rare ones count for
 an enormous amount.
 You would rather be told the truth than be made comfortable. She is constitutionally
 incapable of offering you anything else.
 Underneath all of it she is ferociously protective. She simply refuses to make a
 performance out of caring.
 Do not expect a birthday message. Do expect her to ruin anyone who wrongs you.
 Squid Game · Netflix · 2021–2025 
 Seong Gi-hun 
 You look after whoever is having the worst day. So does he. It is
 the least strategic way to move through the world and the best possible quality in a friend.
 Gi-hun is not the strongest player in Squid Game, or the cleverest. He is the one who
 keeps choosing to protect somebody else, over and over, at genuine cost to himself.
 You have the same instinct. You notice who is struggling and you stay with them, long
 after anybody would blame you for leaving.
 He is a flawed friend, and that is part of why it lands. He lets people down, then comes
 back and tries again, which is more than most manage.
 He would give you his last chance and never once mention that he had done it.
 ↻ RETAKE THE QUIZ 
 As Tommy’s ambitions grow, so do the risks. Every season also follows the seemingly untouchable Tommy pushing his luck further, making increasingly questionable decisions to keep his empire growing . He doesn’t even hesitate to use his own family members as collateral, insisting that it’s all for a greater purpose. That's part of the appeal of Peaky Blinders : watching just how long Tommy can get away with his schemes before his luck finally runs out. When a man who has spent his entire life building an empire finds himself with nothing left, the question becomes whether he can rise from the ashes or if this is finally where his story ends.
 'Peaky Blinders' Brings Together Some of Hollywood's Finest

 Peaky Blinders has no shortage of seasoned actors bringing its characters to life . Besides Murphy’s cutthroat performance as the morally ambiguous and frighteningly intelligent Tommy, the rest of the Shelby family are just as gutsy as their leader, with some arguably even more so. From Paul Anderson as Tommy’s violent but troubled older brother, Arthur Shelby, to Helen McCrory as the wiser and more level-headed Aunt Polly Gray, each family member has a distinct personality that makes them fascinating to watch. Put them all in the same room, though, and their explosive chemistry makes audiences wonder how they haven't killed each other yet.
 The series also boasts an impressive roster of recurring characters, some of whom become regular fixtures in Tommy's life while others only appear for a season or two. Even with limited screen time, these roles attract plenty of talent. Anya Taylor-Joy , Stephen Graham , and Adrien Brody are just a few of the big names who join the cast in later seasons. Then there's Tom Hardy as Alfie Solomons, the leader of a London-based Jewish gang. Appearing across five seasons, Hardy makes for one of Tommy's most entertaining counterparts , with their unpredictable alliance and rivalry providing some of the series' best moments .

 'Peaky Blinders' Sequel Series Is Currently in the Works
 Cillian Murphy in Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man Image via Netflix 
 The original Peaky Blinders series ended in 2022, seemingly sealing Tommy’s fate after six seasons of chasing one impossible high after another. However, the story didn't end there. In March 2026, creator Steven Knight released a feature-film continuation, Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man , set years after the original show's finale. Following its premiere, Netflix doubled down on the franchise by announcing a two-part sequel series focusing on Tommy's sons , Duke ( Jamie Bell ) and Charles Shelby ( Charlie Heaton ). The cast also includes Jessica Brown Findlay , Lashana Lynch , and Lucy Karczewski .
 Set in 1953, the sequel follows the next generation of Shelbys as Birmingham rebuilds itself after World War II . A massive reconstruction project creates new opportunities, but everyone wants a piece of it. At the center of the action is Duke (Bell), now grown up and even more ruthless than when audiences last saw him in The Immortal Man , where Barry Keoghan played the character. Meanwhile, his half-brother Charles (Heaton) has cut ties with the Shelby family and the Peaky Blinders. But once a Shelby, always a Shelby. With a family that endures for all the wrong reasons, Peaky Blinders is a near-perfect binge for anyone who enjoys watching a powerful crime family rise to the top, only to slowly fall apart from within . If you're caught up on MobLand and you're tired of rewatching The Sopranos , it's time to take a journey to Birmingham next.
